description: This file contains TypeScript code defining functions and types related to plugin bundle configuration, including reading JSON objects, handling boundary file failures, inspecting server support, and loading enabled bundle configurations.

methods.name: readBundleJsonObject
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON object from a boundary file, handling errors and boundary conditions.

methods.name: resolveBundleJsonOpenFailure
methods.description: Handles failures when opening boundary files, providing fallback options.

methods.name: inspectBundleServerRuntimeSupport
methods.description: Inspects server support configuration to determine supported and unsupported server names.

methods.name: loadEnabledBundleConfig
methods.description: Loads and merges enabled plugin bundle configurations, returning the final config and diagnostics.
